title: Inter can't afford an experiment vs Shakhtar | Zero points in Europe #Shorts
description:
Inter are top of Serie A and 29th of 36 in Europe. This is no week to experiment.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=48 — the Italian Inter press in English, free every morning.

Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.

CONFIRMED (inter.it, Oct 18): Inter have no points from two Champions League matches and sit 29th of 36. They lost 2–1 at Real Madrid and 4–3 at home to Club Brugge.
REPORTED (La Gazzetta dello Sport via FCInter1908, Oct 19): Ivan Provedel is expected to start against Shakhtar with Josep Martínez rested — a change the paper calls “non risponde a criteri meritocratici”, not a decision made on merit.
REPORTED (Sky Sport Italia and Corriere dello Sport via FCInter1908, Oct 18): Chivu raised his voice in the dressing room at halftime in Bologna, with the match level at 1–1.
CONFIRMED (inter.it, Oct 18): Bologna 1–3 Inter — Pobega 10', Thuram 44', Carlos Augusto 69', Bonny 83'.
NEXT UP: Inter vs Shakhtar Donetsk, Wednesday, October 21 — 3:00 PM ET / 21:00 CEST, US TV: Paramount+ and ViX.
